itemDisplayName: AI Gateway tier (preview) TC01: consume a model via the AI Gateway - Bicep + script
description: Simplest TC01 happy path for the Azure API Management AI Gateway tier (preview). Bicep creates a Microsoft Foundry account, project, and gpt-5.4 model deployment (East US 2, key-based, no user-assigned identity). You then create the gateway and import the model from the standalone AI Gateway tier portal at https://ai.gateway.azure.com, add a token rate-limit policy, and test the model through the gateway with the included Python script (the code equivalent of the portal Discover playground). Verified against https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/api-management/quickstart-ai-gateway-create.
summary: Bicep = Foundry account + project + gpt-5.4 model (steps 1-2). Portal = create AI Gateway tier + Import from Foundry (key-based) + token rate-limit policy (steps 3-4). Script = OpenAI-compatible chat completion through the gateway (step 5, Discover). No UAMI.
